notes_for_editor: Name clash. us-or-rooster-rock is the Linn County site (register US 984, OR 342, 44.41779, -122.30387; gone by 1966), and the Forest Lookouts rooster-rock.html page describes that one. This record is Clackamas County (44.955, -122.325), and rooster-rock1.html carries only the FPA label, the 7S-4E-21 legal location and one 1946 map line. Do not merge the two records. No other source was found for the Clackamas site after one web search; its builder, design, height, staffing and present state are all unknown from the sources. Caution on the county: the Forest Lookouts index also lists a Rooster Rock under LINN COUNTY; the Clackamas attribution rests on the entry's own Clackamas - Marion FPA label and the Clackamas heading in that index.
